author: arjun
title: Set up CI with GitHub Actions
body: Runs lint and unit tests on every push and pull request.
content:
name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.12'}
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest -q

author: sofia
title: BD-101: CSV export endpoint
body: Fixes BD-101. GET /api/tickets/export streams tickets created in the last 30 days as CSV with columns id, subject, status, created_at, assignee.
content:
import csv, io
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

COLUMNS = ['id', 'subject', 'status', 'created_at', 'assignee']


def export_tickets(db, org_id, now=None):
    now = now or datetime.utcnow()
    since = now - timedelta(days=30)
    buf = io.StringIO()
    w = csv.writer(buf)
    w.writerow(COLUMNS)
    for t in db.tickets(org_id=org_id, created_after=since):
        w.writerow([t.id, t.subject, t.status, t.created_at.isoformat(), t.assignee_name])
        yield buf.getvalue(); buf.seek(0); buf.truncate()

title: Login rate limiting
body: Locks an account for 15 minutes after 10 failed logins within 5 minutes (BD-107).
content:
WINDOW_S = 300
MAX_FAILS = 10
LOCK_S = 900


def should_lock(fail_times, now):
    recent = [t for t in fail_times if now - t <= WINDOW_S]
    return len(recent) >= MAX_FAILS
